title: Directory — insurers on the approved product list
content:
Directory of the four insurers on Life Advice Guru's approved product list (APL). Underwriting & New Business uses it through the underwriting_lookupInsurer tool; Insurance Research and Claims use it for contacts, service standards and underwriting thresholds. All insurers, contacts and service standards are fictional. Each insurer's policy numbers carry its prefix. Service standards are each insurer's own targets; the industry timeframes that apply to claims are in 'Claims rules — Life Insurance Code of Practice and income protection benefits'.

• Harbourline Life (policy prefix HL-)
Cover: life (with terminal illness benefit), TPD (any occupation inside or outside super; own occupation outside super only), trauma, income protection; key person and buy-sell cover. No super-linking.
New business: newbusiness@harbourlinelife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1100
Underwriting: underwriting@harbourlinelife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1101
Claims: claims@harbourlinelife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1102
Service standards: application acknowledged within 1 business day; underwriting decision within 5 business days of the last requirement; a named claims consultant within 2 business days of a claim; income protection claim decision usually within 5 business days of receiving all information.
Underwriting thresholds (total life or TPD cover on one life): tele-interview for every application; blood profile from age 46 above $1,000,000; blood profile and medical examination from age 51 above $1,500,000. Income evidence for income protection: latest payslip (employees) or two years' tax returns or BAS and profit and loss statements (self-employed).
Life Advice Guru cases: income protection HL-23051877 (Tom Bradley, REQ-20261111-LIF004 — lodged 12 Nov 2026, accepted 19 Nov 2026).

• Corella Life (policy prefix CR-)
Cover: life (with terminal illness benefit), TPD, trauma, income protection; super-linking — life and any-occupation TPD inside Corella's super plan, with an own-occupation TPD extension, trauma and income protection outside super linked to it; key person and buy-sell cover.
New business: newbusiness@corellalife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1200
Underwriting: underwriting@corellalife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1201
Claims: claims@corellalife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1202
Service standards: tele-interview booked within 2 business days of the application; underwriting decision within 5 business days of the last requirement; a dedicated case manager for every death and terminal illness claim; death claim decision usually within 5 business days of receiving all information, with payment within 3 business days of acceptance.
Underwriting thresholds (total life or TPD cover on one life): ages 18–45 — tele-interview only up to $1,500,000 life or TPD, $500,000 trauma or $10,000 a month income protection; above those amounts or from age 46 — blood profile; from age 51 above $1,500,000 — medical examination.
Life Advice Guru cases: CR-26118204 (Priya Natarajan, REQ-20261103-LIF001 — tele-interview 10 Nov 2026, decision 16 Nov 2026); CR-19033105 (Mei Chen, REQ-20261113-LIF005 — death claim lodged 16 Nov 2026, accepted 20 Nov 2026, paid 23 Nov 2026).

• Lyrebird Life (policy prefix LB-)
Cover: life (with terminal illness benefit), TPD, trauma and income protection for individuals and families. No business protection.
New business: newbusiness@lyrebirdlife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1300
Underwriting: underwriting@lyrebirdlife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1301
Claims: claims@lyrebirdlife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1302
Claims Integrity (fraud) team: integrity@lyrebirdlife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1303 — for alerts about suspected fraud or identity takeover. Life Advice Guru alerts it only after the Practice Team Leader approves.
Service standards: underwriting decision within 7 business days of the last requirement; trauma claim decision usually within 10 business days of receiving all information.
Underwriting thresholds (total life or TPD cover on one life): tele-interview for every application; blood profile from age 46 above $750,000; blood profile and medical examination from age 51 above $1,250,000.
Life Advice Guru cases: LB-19004417 (Grace Williams, REQ-20261106-LIF002 — fraud team alerted 6 Nov 2026; no claim lodged).

• Northbank Life (policy prefix NB-) — strongest in business protection
Cover: life (with terminal illness benefit), TPD, trauma and income protection; buy-sell cover (owned by each owner on their own life, or cross-owned) and key person cover (revenue or capital purpose, owned by the business).
New business: business@northbanklife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1400
Underwriting: underwriting@northbanklife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1401
Claims: claims@northbanklife.example.com.au · (03) 5550 1402
Service standards: fast financial underwriting — accepts the accountant's valuation and the last two years' financial statements as financial evidence, with a financial underwriting decision within 5 business days; medical underwriting decision within 5 business days of the last requirement.
Underwriting thresholds (total life or TPD cover on one life): tele-interview for every application; blood profile from age 46 above $1,000,000; blood profile and medical examination from age 51 above $1,500,000; financial evidence for all business protection (buy-sell: business valuation and two years' financial statements; key person: two years' financial statements and the accountant's estimate of the loss).
Loadings and exclusions: reviewed on request after two years if the client's health results improve.
Life Advice Guru cases: NB-26300418 (George Papadopoulos, buy-sell), NB-26300419 (Harpreet Kaur, buy-sell) and NB-26300420 (key person on George, owned by Northcote Custom Joinery Pty Ltd) — REQ-20261109-LIF003, in force 20 Nov 2026.

Chasing: if an insurer misses its service standard, Uma (underwriting) or Ben (claims) chases by email and phone and tells the client what is happening. Escalate to Theo, the Practice Team Leader, after 10 business days without a response.
